prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry and whether you need strategy, creative, data/analytics, paid performance, or end‑to‑end transformation. I can, however, help you find the best fit. A quick way to proceed is:

1) Quick questions so I can narrow it down
- What’s your budget (monthly or project)?
- Company stage/size (startup, SMB, enterprise)?
- Primary goals (lead gen, brand lift, customer retention, personalization, creative production, chatbot/automation)?
- Channels you care about (paid social, search, email, website personalization, in‑app)?
- Timeline (pilot in 2 months vs. long program)?
- Do you already have internal data/engineering resources?

2) How to evaluate agencies (short checklist you can use)
- Relevant case studies and measurable results for your industry or objective
- Demonstrated AI expertise (ML models, generative AI, automation) and what they actually build vs. vendor hype
- Technology stack & integrations (CDP, analytics, ad platforms, LLMs) and ownership of data
- Team: data scientists/engineers + strategists + creative talent
- Clear KPIs, test plan and attribution approach
- Pricing model and deliverables (retainer, project, revenue share)
- References and examples of ethical/PR-safe AI usage
- Contract exit terms and IP/data ownership

3) Useful interview questions to ask agencies
- Can you show a case where AI drove X% improvement in [relevant KPI] and explain the model/approach?
- Which platforms/LLMs do you use and why? Do you fine‑tune models or rely on prompt engineering?
- How will you integrate with our data sources (CRM, analytics, ad accounts)?
- What does success look like at 30/90/180 days?
- Who will be on the day‑to‑day team and how often will we meet?

4) Red flags
- Lots of buzzwords but no concrete case studies or measurable outcomes
- No clear data/privacy approach
- Promises of impossible overnight results

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 3–5 LA agencies matched to your answers above (I’ll include strengths, sample work, and estimated costs), or
- Compile an RFP template you can send to agencies and help evaluate proposals.

Which would you prefer? If you want the shortlist, tell me your budget, company size and primary objectives.
